title: Codex Review Verdict
description: Structured output for codex review agents. Orchestrator parses this to decide PASS/FAIL and surface findings. Used via `codex exec --output-schema <this file>` per agentic-dev.md §Codex CLI Invocation.

verdict.description: Overall review outcome. FAIL iff at least one critical or important finding exists, OR the self_audit_verification reveals a falsified null-claim.

summary.description: One-paragraph summary of what was verified and any notable observations. Under 200 words.

findings.description: Review findings, grouped implicitly by severity. Empty array on clean PASS.

severity.description: critical = blocks merge; important = fix before merge; optional = nit.

file.description: Repo-root-relative path to the offending file. Null if the finding is not file-local (e.g. missing gate, global policy breach).

line.description: Line number inside `file`. Null if not applicable.

suggested_fix.description: Concrete action the fix agent should take. Should be specific enough that the fix agent can act without re-deriving context.

self_audit_verification.description: Result of the §3a 'Verify self-audit' gate in run-review.md. Required unless the impl handoff genuinely has no scope that could produce stale artifacts (rare).

claim_checked.description: Which claim from the impl handoff's §'Stale artifact self-audit' section was cross-checked.

grep_command.description: The exact grep the reviewer re-ran to cross-check.

result.description: consistent = agent's claim matched reviewer's re-run; discrepancy = reviewer found matches the agent didn't list; null_claim_falsified = agent said 'None found' but reviewer found plausible stale artifacts (auto-FAIL).
